payload.comment: Root cause: FakeRenderEngine's gated preview park used an uncancellable continuation, so after navigation cancelled the settled job, ImageWorkScheduler (which correctly holds a cancelled job's editor-lane slot in draining until its task returns) never freed the lane and the next photo's render never started. Fix is test-only: Tests/KromoraKitTests/FakeRenderEngine.swift parks now observe cancellation (with a registration-race guard). No production/scheduler change; lane limits intact. Extended PreviewCutoverTests/testOrphanedSettledPreviewDoesNotBlockTheNextPhoto to assert the second photo settles after release. Results: isolated test passed 3 consecutive runs; PreviewCutover, PreviewCoordinator, ComparisonMode, EmbeddedFirstFrame, PresentationBudget, WarmReopenPresentation, ThumbnailSwitchLifecycle: 99 tests, 0 failures.
